title: ApproverGrantAssertionV1
description: Console-signed assertion that a console user holding a specific approver grant approved one specific approval, after a server-side step-up. Evidence for the `atlasent_approver_grant` approver basis (atlasent-api#3863). It takes the place of `identity_assertion` in an approval_artifact.v1 (never both). The principal is (issuer.issuer_id, subject.principal_id); the runtime authorizes it only through an approver grant issued to exactly that pair, re-checked under a row lock when the approval commits and again when a permit is claimed. Lifetime is at most five minutes and the step-up at most five minutes old when minted; both are enforced by the runtime verifier, not by this schema. Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of every field except `signature`, under a key from the runtime's APPROVER_GRANT_TRUSTED_ISSUERS. Mirrors atlasent-api/supabase/functions/_shared/approver_grant_assertion.ts (ApproverGrantAssertionV1 / isApproverGrantAssertion); mirrored in atlasent/schemas/v1_1/approver-grant-assertion.schema.json (checked by contract/tools/check_root_schema_mirror.py). The SDK only carries it; it never signs or verifies. Wire-stable as `approver_grant_assertion.v1`. Added 2026-10-03 (atlasent-api#3876), additive only.

grant_id.description: The approver grant the console read for this person (lower-case UUID).

acr.description: Authenticator assurance level of the console session when minted.

amr.description: Methods the session authenticated with (RFC 8176 style), recorded as evidence.
